job.title: Job Application for Senior QA Engineer at VML/WPP ...

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Engineer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, data integration between PIM, ERP and MDM, SQL performance tuning, and CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Git. Proven record of code reviews, production support, and agile delivery with Jira and international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior QA Engineer
cover_en.hook: I am excited to apply for the Senior QA Engineer role at VML/WPP because of your reputation for delivering cutting-edge digital commerce experiences. With over five years designing, building and testing SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep e-commerce platform expertise and a strong focus on quality.

bullets.label: eCommerce Platform Expertise
bullets.text: I have delivered large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) implementations, mastering platform architecture, data models and custom extensions, directly aligning with your need for Hybris experience.

bullets.label: Test Automation & Quality
bullets.text: My work includes extensive unit and integration testing with JUnit, automated regression pipelines, and rigorous code reviews that ensure high-quality releases.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Jenkins
bullets.text: I routinely executed CI/CD deployment cycles on Jenkins and SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), streamlining build, test and release processes.

bullets.label: Agile Issue Tracking
bullets.text: Using Jira daily, I tracked defects, managed sprints and coordinated with international stakeholders to resolve production issues swiftly.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: VML/WPP stands at the forefront of digital marketing and commerce innovation, creating immersive brand experiences for global clients. Your commitment to data-driven, omnichannel solutions aligns with my passion for building robust e-commerce platforms that scale worldwide. I am eager to contribute my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help VML/WPP deliver seamless, high-performing digital experiences that drive client success.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join VML/WPP to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud and QA expertise to your cutting-edge digital commerce projects, enhancing quality and delivery speed.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud engineer with 5+ years of e-commerce platform experience. I’m keen on the Senior QA Engineer role at VML/WPP and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your CI/CD pipelines on Jenkins, integrate OCC APIs with your front-end frameworks, and streamline PIM/ERP data flows to improve release stability. My proven production support experience will also reduce downtime and accelerate issue resolution.
tailoring.insight: I noticed the role highlights Jenkins for automated testing; I can leverage my extensive Jenkins CI/CD experience to optimize your release pipelines and ensure high-quality deployments.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior QA Engineer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud engineer based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit. VML/WPP’s leadership in digital commerce excites me, and I can bring immediate value through my Jenkins CI/CD expertise, Hybris platform mastery, and strong QA practices. I also observed your focus on automated testing pipelines, which aligns with my experience. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
